LanguageData.RT_Rec1: The Dice storyteller announces every roll and shows today's odds.
LanguageData.RT_Rec2: The storyteller sometimes comments on events (about every third one).
LanguageData.RT_Rec3: Works with any storyteller; nothing changes in your save.
LanguageData.RT_DiceAlert_Desc: An alert on the right: today's roll, what kind of day it is, the odds of a raid, of small threats and of traders or visitors, and the time until the next roll.
LanguageData.RT_DiceLetter_Desc: The daily roll comes as a letter with the full forecast instead of a short message.
LanguageData.RT_Diary_Desc: Now and then the storyteller comments on an event with a short line at the top of the screen.
LanguageData.RT_DiaryAll_Desc: Comments also with Randy, Cassandra, Phoebe and storytellers from other mods – not only with the ones from this mod.
LanguageData.RT_DiaryChance_Desc: How often a comment comes. There is always at least a few hours between two comments.
LanguageData.RT_MoodDesc1: 1 – Calm day. No big threats today, few events, weak small threats. The sky clears up.
LanguageData.RT_MoodDesc2: 2 – Easy day. Big threats are rare, more visitors and harmless events; often something nice comes and the weather may change.
LanguageData.RT_MoodDesc3: 3 – Ordinary day. Everything as with Randy; now and then one more event or a change of weather.
LanguageData.RT_MoodDesc4: 4 – Generous day. Traders and visitors come more often, fewer threats, one gift during the day and fine weather.
LanguageData.RT_MoodDesc5: 5 – Hard day. Big and small threats are much more likely and stronger – at least one surely comes during the day. The worst weather this place knows.
LanguageData.RT_MoodDesc6: 6 – Mad day. Events come twice as often and every kind has its own random chance – at least two random events (vanilla and mods) surely come and any weather can show up.
LanguageData.RT_FcNoForced: Even an overdue raid waits for another day.
LanguageData.RT_FcGift: A gift is on its way today.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay1_1: Snake eyes. Take a nap, I'll be back tomorrow.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay1_2: One. Even I need a day off.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay1_3: A one. Enjoy it, it won't last.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay2_1: Two. I'm in a good mood. Don't ruin it.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay2_2: A two – tea, biscuits, no explosions.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay3_2: A three. Let's see what the day brings… I don't know either.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay4_1: Four! Somebody up there likes you.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay4_2: A four. Open the doors, guests are coming.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay4_3: Four. I feel generous. Don't get used to it.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay5_2: A five. I hope your walls are thick.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay5_3: Five. Today the dice want blood.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay6_2: A six. I don't even know what happens next.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay6_3: Six. Chaos is a ladder. Or a pit. We'll see.
LanguageData.RT_D_Raid_2: They heard you have a nice base. They want it.
LanguageData.RT_D_Raid_3: Raiders! I didn't send them. Probably.
LanguageData.RT_D_Raid_4: Somebody ordered trouble? Delivery is here.
LanguageData.RT_D_Manhunter_1: The animals have had enough of you.
LanguageData.RT_D_Infestation_1: Something is crawling in the walls. Sleep tight.
LanguageData.RT_D_Infestation_3: You dug too deep. They noticed.
LanguageData.RT_D_Pod_1: Something fell from the sky. Finders keepers.
LanguageData.RT_D_Pod_2: Free stuff! Don't ask where it came from.
LanguageData.RT_D_Wanderer_1: A new friend! Or a future problem.
LanguageData.RT_D_Wanderer_2: Someone wants to join. Be nice.
LanguageData.RT_D_Dark_1: Lights out. Hope you like candles.
LanguageData.RT_D_Dark_2: The sun took a break. So did your power.
LanguageData.RT_D_Weather_2: Dress for the occasion. The occasion is suffering.
LanguageData.RT_D_Big_2: This one is going to hurt.
LanguageData.RT_D_Big_3: I warned you. Didn't I? I meant to.
LanguageData.RT_D_Small_1: Just a little something to keep you awake.
LanguageData.RT_D_Small_2: A small problem. Small for now.
LanguageData.RT_D_Trade_2: A trader in orbit. Bring your silver.
LanguageData.RT_D_Misc_3: I did not see that coming. Neither did you.
LanguageData.RT_MoodDesc7: 7 – The die rolled off the table! He throws again in a few hours; an ordinary day until then.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay7_1: Seven? This die has no seven… rolling again.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay7_2: It fell under the table. Give me a moment.
LanguageData.RT_RollSay7_3: Seven. That does not count. Once more, in a while.
LanguageData.RT_HeavySix: Heaviest threats only on a mad day (6)
LanguageData.RT_HeavySix_Desc: With Mad Dice Max, infestations, mechanoid clusters and crashed ship parts come only when the die shows 6. Quests are not affected.
LanguageData.RT_Events_Desc: After a roll, Mad Dice Max may bring one of his own events that fits the day: bets, challenges with a deadline, situations for a few days, twisted vanilla events.
LanguageData.RT_EventChance: Chance of an event after a roll: {0} %
LanguageData.RT_EventChance_Desc: How often a day brings one of Max's events.
LanguageData.RT_EventListDesc: Untick the events you don't want. Each one belongs to one face of the die. Hover for a description.
LanguageData.RT_EV_NoSilver: You don't have {0} silver to bet.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Festival_Text: "Put the work away for a moment. Today we celebrate – just because the dice said so."\n\nEveryone is in a festive mood for two days.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Dreams_Text: "Sleep well tonight. I'll watch the dice."\n\nFor two days sleep refreshes your colonists more.
LanguageData.RT_EV_LostDie_Text: "I dropped a die somewhere around here. Whoever finds it can keep what's with it."\n\nA pod falls near your colony.
LanguageData.RT_EV_QuietDays_Text: "Three days without anyone losing their temper. Can you do it?"
LanguageData.RT_EV_QuietDays_Goal: no mental break for three days
LanguageData.RT_EV_QuietDays_Won: "I didn't believe it. Well done."\n\nEveryone is proud of the team and two colonists get an inspiration.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Lesson_Text: "Let me show you a trick or two."\n\nThree colonists improve their best skill.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Crafter_Text: "Show me your hands are good for more than holding dice."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Crafter_Won: "Fine work. Here's something for the next ones."\n\nComponents and plasteel are on the way.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Hunter_Text: "I'm hungry for a good hunt story."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Hunter_Won: "Now that's a story!"\n\nThe hunters are proud and a bag of silver falls from the sky.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Cleaning_Text: "This place is a mess. Clean it up by tomorrow and I'll make it worth it."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Cleaning_Won: "Sparkling. Even I want to live here."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Focus_Text: "Today everything sticks. Learn while you can."\n\nFor two days your colonists learn 50 % faster.
LanguageData.RT_EV_OddEven_Text: "A little bet? Even – you win. Odd – I keep your silver."
LanguageData.RT_EV_OddEven_Lose: The die shows {0}. Your {1} silver is gone.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Miner_Won: "Told you so."\n\nGold and silver are on the way.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Builder_Won: "That'll stand for a while."\n\nSteel and components are on the way.
LanguageData.RT_EV_GoldFever_Text: "Every rock might hide a fortune…"\n\nFor two days mining yields 50 % more, but nerves are thin.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Reroll_Text: "I don't like today's number. Let me throw again."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Roulette_Text: "One of your people, one throw. Heads – a stroke of genius. Tails – a bruise."
LanguageData.RT_EV_LuckyHand_Text: "The dice smile on you."\n\nFor three days surgery succeeds more often and your words persuade better (recruiting, trade).
LanguageData.RT_EV_Pilgrim_Text: "Someone is coming who wants to join you. Someone else may come looking for him."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Blessing_Text: "Today the work goes by itself."\n\nFor a day everyone works 25 % faster.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Supplies_Text: "Eat. You look thin."\n\nA pod with meals falls nearby.
LanguageData.RT_EV_TwoSides_Text: "One raid is boring. How about two?"\n\nTwo smaller raids are coming at once.
LanguageData.RT_EV_BadLuck_Text: "Everything will go wrong today. At least you'll learn something."\n\nFor a day everyone moves 10 % slower but learns twice as fast.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Fortress_Text: "Here they come. Hold the walls and don't lose anyone."\n\nA raid is coming right now.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Fortress_Won: "A real fortress."\n\nA mini-turret and steel are on the way.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Tax_Text: "A fifth of your silver for me – or I send someone to take it."
LanguageData.RT_EV_ColdShower_Text: "Too comfortable? Let's change the weather."\n\nFor two days it gets very cold (or very hot in summer).
LanguageData.RT_EV_AllIn_Text: "One throw. 4 to 6 – a fortune falls from the sky. 1 to 3 – a strong raid comes for you."
LanguageData.RT_EV_MadPack_Text: "The animals went mad. Lots of them."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Eclipse_Text: "Let's play in the dark for a while."\n\nAn eclipse, and something whispers numbers.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Revenge_Text: "You've been lucky lately. Too lucky."\n\nA strong raid is coming.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Double_Text: "Two dice today: one for you, one against you."
LanguageData.RT_EV_NoRaid: Max waves his hand – on this difficulty he sends nobody.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Stargazing_Text: "Look up tonight. I lit a few extra ones just for you."\n\nEveryone enjoys a night under the stars.
LanguageData.RT_EV_GreenThumb_Text: "Your plants are listening today."\n\nFor two days sowing and harvesting go 50 % faster.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Guests_Text: "I invited some friends. Be nice to them."\n\nVisitors are on their way.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Balm_Text: "Let me see those scratches… better."\n\nThe wounds of your colonists heal a little.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Cook_Won: "Delicious. A feast for everyone!"\n\nEveryone enjoys the feast and a bag of silver falls from the sky.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Scholar_Text: "Show me how much a head can hold."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Scholar_Won: "Clever people. Here's something to think about."\n\nTwo colonists get an inspiration and a pod with goods is on the way.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Gardener_Text: "Bring in the harvest – I want to see full baskets."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Gardener_Won: "Full baskets! Well done."\n\nSilver is on the way.
LanguageData.RT_EV_HighLow_Text: "One die. Guess high – four to six – or low – one to three. 150 silver, double back."
LanguageData.RT_EV_HighLow_Lose: The die shows {0}. Your {1} silver is gone.
LanguageData.RT_EV_SteadyHands_Text: "Today your hands won't shake."\n\nFor two days building and hauling go 30 % faster.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Market_Text: "I told the traders where to find you."\n\nA trade caravan is on its way.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Sower_Won: "Now let it grow."\n\nSilver is on the way.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Swap_Text: "Give me 100 silver and I'll give you whatever is in this sack. Could be more. Could be less."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Tales_Text: "Gather round. Let me tell you about the time I lost a whole planet at dice…"\n\nEveryone enjoys the stories.
LanguageData.RT_EV_RainDance_Text: "Too dry. Let me roll for rain."\n\nIt starts to rain.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Tamer_Won: "Look at them, best friends already."\n\nSilver is on the way.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Windfall_Text: "Found some silver in my other pocket. It's yours."\n\nA pod with silver falls near your colony.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Medkit_Text: "In case you break something. You will."\n\nA pod with medicine falls near your colony.
LanguageData.RT_EV_MysteryBox_Text: "A closed box. Something good inside – probably. Or I can just buy it back from you."
LanguageData.RT_EV_MysteryBox_O2: Sell it to Max for 300 silver
LanguageData.RT_EV_MysteryBox_Lose: The box was full of angry animals!
LanguageData.RT_EV_Muse_Text: "I whispered ideas into a few ears."\n\nThree colonists get an inspiration.
LanguageData.RT_EV_StrayHerd_Text: "Some animals followed my dice. Keep them."\n\nA few tame animals wander in.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Blight_Text: "Oops. I dropped a die in your field."\n\nBlight strikes your crops.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Sickness_Text: "Somebody sneezed on my dice."\n\nA disease breaks out.
LanguageData.RT_EV_Fallout_Text: "The sky is sick today. Stay inside."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Toll_Text: "Raiders have heard of you. Pay them off – about 80 silver per colonist – or fight. If you fight, I'll leave you something for your trouble."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Flare_Text: "I polished the sun. Your machines won't like it."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Swarm_Text: "Do you hear the crawling under the floor?"
LanguageData.RT_EV_Drone_Text: "Something hums in the dark. Max is not laughing."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Jackpot_Text: "Two dice. A double and you win big. Anything else and I send someone to collect."
LanguageData.RT_EV_Jackpot_Lose: The dice show {0} and {1}. Someone comes to collect!
LanguageData.RT_EV_LongNight_Text: "I covered the sun with my hand. For a few days."
LanguageData.RT_EV_IronDice_Text: "Metal dice fall from the sky. They don't stop rolling."
